articles.zh: 一词多义：jam 到底有几种意思？
body: The word 'jam' is a small but busy word in English, and it can mean very different things depending on the situation.
英语里 jam 这个词虽短，却很"忙"——在不同场景下意思差别很大。
You might spread fruit jam on your toast, get stuck in a traffic jam on the way to work, or jam with friends when you play music together without a plan.
你可能在吐司上抹果酱，上班路上遇到交通堵塞，也可能和朋友们随兴合奏音乐。
In everyday chat, people also say they are 'jammed' when they are too busy to do anything else, so the same word can be food, traffic, music or a full schedule.
日常对话里，人们还会说自己是 jammed（忙得不可开交），所以这个词既能指食物、交通，也能指音乐或排得满满的日程。

articles.zh: 地道表达：understood the assignment（把任务完成得漂亮）
body: 'Understood the assignment' is a casual way to praise someone who did exactly what was needed, and did it well.
understood the assignment 是一句口语，用来夸某人"完全接住了任务"，而且完成得很出色。
It started in workplaces and schools, but now people use it online for anything from a great outfit to a perfect reply.
它最早来自职场和校园，但现在网上啥都能用——从一身好穿搭到一句神回复。
If your friend brings the right snack to a movie night, you can joke that they really understood the assignment.
比如朋友看电影夜带对了零食，你就能调侃说：你这回可真是 understood the assignment。
tips: 把任务完成得漂亮（口语夸人）

articles.zh: 一分钟英语：含 money 的常用短语
body: English has many short phrases built around the word 'money', and they often describe value, effort or attitude rather than coins.
英语里有不少以 money 为核心的短短语，它们往往描述价值、付出或态度，而不只是硬币本身。
For example, 'time is money' reminds us that wasted time is wasted opportunity, while 'money doesn't grow on trees' warns us to spend carefully.
比如 time is money 提醒我们浪费时间就是浪费机会，而 money doesn't grow on trees 则劝人花钱要谨慎。
You can also say 'for my money' to give your own opinion, or 'make money' when talking about earning it — small phrases with big everyday use.
你还能用 for my money 来表达自己的看法，或用 make money 说赚钱——都是日常高频小短语。

articles.zh: 地道表达：sell yourself short（低估自己）
body: To 'sell yourself short' means to underestimate your own ability or value, often by not aiming high enough.
sell yourself short 意思是低估自己的能力或价值，常表现为不敢定更高的目标。
A friend might say this to you when you turn down a chance because you don't think you are good enough.
当你因为觉得自己不够好而拒绝一个机会时，朋友可能就会对你说这句话。
It comes from the idea of selling something for less than it is worth, so the advice is simple: know your worth and ask for more.
它源自"把东西贱卖"的比喻，所以核心建议很简单：认清自己的价值，敢要更多。

articles.zh: 一分钟英语：含 eye 的常用短语
body: The word 'eye' appears in many English phrases that have nothing to do with actually seeing something.
eye 这个词出现在很多英语短语里，却和"真的用眼睛看"没啥关系。
'Keep an eye on' means to watch or take care of something, while 'in the blink of an eye' describes something that happens very fast.
keep an eye on 是"照看、留意"的意思，而 in the blink of an eye 形容事情发生得飞快。
You might also hear 'see eye to eye' when two people agree, so a single body part gives us useful ways to talk about care, speed and agreement.
两个人意见一致时，你会听到 see eye to eye，所以这一个身体部位就帮我们表达关心、速度和共识。
tips: in the blink of an eye
